Failure symptom: Once a new Skill is set up and confirmed that it is ready in the Skill list, whether it restarts the gateway or restarts the entire machine, Agent still doesn't get this new Skill with the old session snapshot. Whether or not delivery is therefore dependent on the judgment of the receiver model, which often opts for silence and the output is silently discarded; while cron only records Agent's running successes, unsustainable delivery results, and failures are invisible under bestEffort.
